conversationHistory.body: Hi Ruby & Jerome! I am so excited to come and stay at your rental! My partner and I are driving from Michigan and it's our first time in Maine. We would love to have some recommendations of things to do and places to eat. We will be bringing our dog Rosie! Thank you so much!

Good afternoon, Rene,

Thanks for the note — sounds like a wonderful first trip to Maine! We're delighted to host you and Rosie. The $30 pet fee is already included in your reservation. Please remember pets are not allowed on the bed or sofa.

Check-in is at 4pm with self-check-in and you have one dedicated off-street parking spot. I will send the detailed check-in instructions 3 days before your arrival.

For recommendations on things to do and places to eat, the Old Port and waterfront area have lots of great options within a short walk or drive. Looking forward to hosting you in Portland.

Jerome & Ruby
Thank you so much! I appreciate your prompt response! We are super excited!
